topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It's a strange sensation, discovering that the pages we’ve held close, the stories we thought were etched in memory, are forgotten by the one who lived them with us. I found myself standing in the echo of those lost memories, almost as if I were holding a conversation with silence. But it’s in these moments that we remember, don’t we? The memories, even if one-sided, are a part of who we are. They’ve shaped our landscape, influenced our smile, guided our choices. I realized, it’s not about the parallel paths we once walked together, but the person I’ve become because of those steps. And that’s something no one can take away.
